haki.description: Allows user to sense others' presence, strength, and emotions.
Coats user's body or attacks in an invisible armor of willpower.
Overpowers the will of others, capable of knocking out weaker opponents.

abilities.name: Hiken
abilities.description: Launches a massive column of fire.

abilities.name: Enkai
abilities.description: Creates a large fireball for devastating attacks.

devilFruits.name: Mera Mera no Mi
devilFruits.properties: Grants the ability to control, create, and transform into fire, allowing the user to generate flames at will and become intangible as fire.

devilFruits.name: Gomu Gomu no Mi
devilFruits.properties: Grants user a rubber-like body, allowing him to stretch and withstand physical damage.

devilFruits.name: Gura Gura no Mi
devilFruits.properties: Grants the ability to create powerful shockwaves or tremors, capable of causing massive destruction by creating vibrations in the air, sea, or ground.

devilFruits.name: Magu Magu no Mi
devilFruits.properties: Grants the ability to create, control, and transform into magma, allowing the user to generate extremely hot lava and control it for offensive and defensive purposes.

devilFruits.name: Pika Pika no Mi
devilFruits.properties: Grants the ability to create, control, and transform into light, allowing the user to move at the speed of light, create blinding flashes, and manipulate light for attacks or illusions.

devilFruits.name: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Daibutsu
devilFruits.properties: Grants the ability to transform into a giant, powerful Buddha, as well as a human form. The user gains enormous physical strength, heightened durability, and the ability to unleash powerful spiritual attacks.
